thread.title: Stock market opens lower as rare forecast cut by Apple unsettles Wall Street

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Stock market opens lower as rare forecast cut by Apple unsettles Wall Street
text:
U.S.stock indexes opened solidly lower Thursday as investors got their first chance to react to a late-Wednesday announcement from Apple Inc. The iPhone maker cut its sales forecast, citing softness in China's economy, underscoring fears that the world's second-largest economy is contracting. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.40% declined 240 points, or 1.1%, at 23,103, the S&P 500 index SPX, -1.01% fell 0.7% at 2,494, and the technology and internet-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -1.34% declined by 1.2% at 6,588. Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -8.81% were down 8.4% . By dint of its outsize market value and its share price, Apple's stock-price moves are influential in the Nasdaq and S&P 500 and the price-weighted Dow. On the data front, private-sector employment jumped in December, as employers added a better-than-expected 271,000 jobs, Automatic Data Processing ADP, -0.91% reported. In corporate news, Bristol-Myers Squibb Co. BMY, -12.53% announced a $74 billion cash-and-stock acquisition of Celgene Corp CELG, +28.86%
